name: zinput_keyboard_wait_for_any_key_press
description: zInput::Keyboard_WaitForAnyKeyPress reads one buffered keyboard event, updates transition/modifier state, handles input-lost acquisition, and returns the first pressed key code.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF target zinput_keyboard_wait_for_any_key_press covers the wait-event function and its keyboard device/event-buffer/modifier/table globals.
The function-byte compare now passes with zero unmasked mismatches after relocation masking; covered data symbols 0x561cc8, 0x561ccc, 0x561cd0, and 0x561cd4 also pass with zero unmasked mismatches.
